To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the inclusion of online product reviews improves the accuracy of early postrelease revenue forecasting for motion pictures, and (2) online review metrics are more useful in forecasting motion picture revenue than are professional critic review metrics, but less useful than theater availability metrics.

(1) a diffusion model that incorporates online product review metrics is superior to a benchmark diffusion model that only includes prerelease marketing and critic reviews in the context of early forecasting of motion picture box office revenue, and (2) the online metrics that have the strongest predictive power are the percentage of positive reviews and the percentage of positive professional critic reviews.
online review metrics are important predictors of entertainment goods' sales and that they are more valuable in forecasting very early post-release entertainment goods' sales.
